title: Freeze portable Git release snapshots
goal: Implement an exact-source snapshot publisher with durable retry evidence, safe concurrent publication and no GitHub dependency, without weakening existing main or production qualification gates.
checkpoint: Isolated implementation candidate; 15 regression tests written but compilation/execution waits for the shared gate owner. Rustfmt passed. Independent source review found endpoint routing, complete-file sync and push URL parsing races; fixes and regressions are present but not yet executed. Native runtime import added; required xtask/build.rs local-snapshot entry remains blocked by another frozen claim. Main publisher wiring, workspace checks and production qualification are not claimed. Remote immutable snapshot uses a standard tag; release branch creation is local only because force flags are prohibited.
